translations.answer: Confirm that the version includes PR #1067. The maintainer explicitly identified an Armijo condition error in issue #743: it causes the solver to perform extra iterations after finding a solution, and the convergence is not guaranteed during random initialization; this issue is not a conclusion of the factorization solver. PR #1067 recalculates the free-subspace gradient/search direction and checks convergence on the updated free-gradient infinity norm. The fix should still be applied to the target MPC problem, and the KKT residual should be compared with the iteration upper bound.
translations.applicability: Applies to Crocoddyl BoxQP/Box(F)DDP paths missing PR #1067, especially in cases of random initialization and extra iterations.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and there is no conflict, and there is formal documentation or precise independent replication.
translations.details.attempts.0: Compare the new and old active set, gradient norm, linear/exponential line search, and multiple factorizations.
translations.details.attempts.1: PR #1067 corrects the free-subspace gradient/search direction and convergence check, and updates the identity-Hessian regularized test.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: First check if the target version includes PR #1067, then discuss LLT/LDLT/PivLU or line-search schedule.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Record iteration count, termination reason, and KKT/free-gradient norm using a fixed random QP set.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Upgrade to a version containing PR #1067 / merge commit d5c387e in Crocoddyl.
translations.details.environments.0: Crocoddyl 2020–2022 BoxQP changes discussed; original post contains a side-by-side Exotica quadcopter benchmark but lacks uniform hardware/commit.
translations.details.limits.0: The discussion about factorization performance in issue #743 did not form a universally adoptable conclusion, so this card does not recommend a specific decomposition method.
translations.details.limits.1: The 90%/30% speedup attributed to the original author was from unmerged changes, and cannot be attributed to PR #1067.
translations.details.limits.2: Do not use the original post's performance graph as evidence here.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The maintainer explains that the fix avoids useless iterations after finding a solution and restores convergence during random initialization; PR has been merged.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Is the extra iteration after finding a solution necessarily caused by the matrix decomposition?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Real-time MPC upgrade should perform regression on worst-case iterations, KKT residual, deadline miss, and fallback.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The maintainer explicitly identifies this as an Armijo condition error, not a factorization solver.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The solver finds a solution and continues with extra iterations.
translations.details.symptoms.1: Convergence is not guaranteed during random initialization.
translations.source.title: BoxQP random initialization extra iterations: fix Armijo condition
translations.title: When BoxQP finds a solution but continues with extra iterations and random initialization is unstable, what should be checked first?
